frontMatter.welcome:
Welcome to IMS.
We are delighted that you have chosen to be part of our team. At IMS, we believe that our people are the foundation of our success. Every individual contributes unique skills, perspectives, and experiences that help us deliver exceptional results for our clients and create a positive impact within our communities.
Joining IMS means becoming part of a collaborative, innovative, and supportive environment where people are encouraged to learn, grow, and succeed together. Whether you are starting a new role, advancing your career, or exploring new opportunities, we are committed to providing the support and resources you need to thrive.
frontMatter.about:
Integrated Merchandising Solutions (IMS) is a global retail services organization dedicated to helping brands and retailers improve operational performance, strengthen customer experiences, and achieve sustainable growth.
Through expertise, innovation, and strong partnerships, we deliver solutions that create value for our clients while maintaining a commitment to responsible business practices and long-term sustainability.
Our success is built on the dedication of our people, the trust of our clients, and a culture that encourages continuous improvement and collaboration.
This guide has been created to introduce you to life at IMS.
It provides an overview of our culture, values, ways of working, and the principles that shape our workplace. It is designed to help you understand what we stand for, what you can expect from IMS, and how each of us contributes to creating a positive and successful work environment.
Within these pages, you will discover:
- Our purpose, vision, and values.
- How we work together and support one another.
- Our commitment to health, safety, and wellbeing.
- Opportunities for learning, development, and career growth.
- The importance of ethics, integrity, and accountability.
- Our approach to sustainability and social responsibility.
Our purpose is to create lasting value through exceptional service, innovative thinking, and responsible business practices.
We strive to make a meaningful difference for our clients, our colleagues, our communities, and the environment by working with integrity, professionalism, and a shared commitment to excellence.
To be a trusted partner recognized for delivering outstanding solutions, fostering innovation, and creating sustainable value for all stakeholders.

chapters.title: Professional Conduct
chapters.text:
As representatives of IMS, employees are expected to conduct themselves professionally and responsibly at all times.
Professional conduct includes:
- Treating colleagues, clients, suppliers, and visitors with courtesy and respect.
- Acting honestly and ethically in all business interactions.
- Maintaining professionalism in verbal, written, and digital communications.
- Taking responsibility for actions and decisions.
- Demonstrating reliability and accountability in daily work.
Professionalism helps build trust, strengthen relationships, and maintain the reputation of IMS.
## Respect in the Workplace
Respect is fundamental to a healthy and productive work environment.
At IMS, we value diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We expect all employees to contribute to a workplace where individuals feel welcomed, respected, and included.
Employees are encouraged to:
- Listen actively to others.
- Communicate respectfully, even during disagreements.
- Appreciate different viewpoints and experiences.
- Support a workplace free from discrimination, harassment, bullying, or inappropriate behavior.
- Foster positive working relationships across teams and functions.
## Communication & Collaboration
Effective communication is essential to our success.
We encourage employees to communicate openly, honestly, and professionally while sharing information, ideas, and feedback that support teamwork and continuous improvement.
Strong collaboration includes:
- Sharing knowledge and expertise.
- Supporting colleagues when assistance is needed.
- Participating constructively in meetings and discussions.
- Working across teams to achieve common goals.
- Addressing challenges respectfully and proactively.
By working together, we create stronger outcomes for our clients and each other.
## Workplace Etiquette
A respectful workplace is created through everyday actions and behaviors.
Employees are encouraged to:
- Be punctual and prepared for meetings and commitments.
- Maintain a professional and respectful tone in all communications.
- Respect shared workspaces and company property.
- Be considerate of colleagues' time and responsibilities.
- Contribute to a positive and supportive work environment.
Small actions can have a significant impact on workplace culture and employee experience.
## Responsible Use of Company Resources
IMS provides employees with the tools, technology, information, and resources needed to perform their roles effectively.
Employees are expected to:
- Use company resources responsibly and for legitimate business purposes.
- Protect company assets from loss, misuse, or damage.
- Follow established guidelines for technology and information use.
- Report any concerns regarding misuse or security risks.
Responsible use of resources helps ensure efficiency, security, and business continuity.
## Representing IMS
Whether interacting with clients, suppliers, business partners, or members of the public, employees play an important role in representing IMS.
Employees are encouraged to:
- Act professionally and respectfully.
- Uphold the values and reputation of IMS.
- Communicate accurately and responsibly.
- Demonstrate integrity in all business interactions.
Every interaction contributes to how IMS is perceived by others.
## Working Together for Success
Our workplace culture is strengthened when employees support one another, communicate openly, and act with professionalism and respect.
By working together and living our values every day, we create a workplace where people can thrive, collaborate effectively, and contribute to the continued success of IMS.
## Health, Safety & Wellbeing
## Our Commitment
At IMS, the health, safety, and wellbeing of our employees are a top priority. We are committed to providing a work environment where people feel safe, supported, respected, and empowered to perform at their best.
Creating a safe workplace is a shared responsibility. Every employee plays an important role in maintaining a healthy and secure environment by following safe work practices, remaining aware of potential risks, and supporting the wellbeing of colleagues.
IMS is committed to continuously improving health, safety, and wellbeing performance across all operations.
To support this commitment, IMS aims to:
- Maintain a workplace free from serious work-related injuries and fatalities.
- Provide health and safety awareness training to employees as appropriate to their roles.
- Encourage the reporting of hazards, incidents, and near misses to support preventive action.
- Continuously improve workplace safety practices through monitoring, review, and corrective actions.
- Promote employee physical, mental, and emotional wellbeing through ongoing awareness and support initiatives.
These objectives are reviewed periodically as part of IMS's commitment to continual improvement.
## A Safe Workplace for Everyone
IMS strives to maintain workplaces that are safe, secure, and free from hazards.

chapters.title: Emergency Preparedness
chapters.text:
IMS is committed to ensuring employees are aware of appropriate actions during emergencies.
Employees should:
- Familiarize themselves with emergency procedures applicable to their workplace.
- Follow instructions provided by designated emergency coordinators.
- Report emergencies, incidents, or safety concerns promptly.
- Participate in safety briefings or drills when required.
Preparedness helps protect employees and supports an effective response during unexpected situations.
## Reporting Safety Concerns
Employees are encouraged to immediately report:
- Workplace hazards.
- Unsafe conditions or practices.
- Accidents, injuries, or near misses.
- Security concerns.
- Situations that may impact employee wellbeing.
Reports will be handled appropriately, and employees raising genuine concerns in good faith will be treated respectfully and without fear of retaliation.
## Looking After One Another
Creating a safe and healthy workplace is a collective effort.
By remaining aware, acting responsibly, and supporting one another, we help create an environment where everyone can work confidently, safely, and successfully.
At IMS, safety and wellbeing are not just workplace priorities—they are part of our commitment to our people.
## Learning, Development & Career Growth
## Growing Together
At IMS, we believe that continuous learning and professional development are essential to both individual and organizational success. We are committed to creating an environment where employees are encouraged to expand their knowledge, strengthen their skills, and pursue opportunities for growth.
Learning is an ongoing journey, and we encourage every employee to take an active role in their personal and professional development.
## A Culture of Learning
We believe that learning happens every day through experiences, collaboration, feedback, and formal development opportunities.
Employees are encouraged to:
- Continuously develop their knowledge and skills.
- Stay informed about industry trends and best practices.
- Share expertise and learn from colleagues.
- Seek opportunities to broaden their experience.
- Embrace new challenges and responsibilities.
Learning not only supports individual growth but also strengthens our ability to deliver value to clients and stakeholders.

chapters.title: Training & Development Opportunities
chapters.text:
IMS supports employee development through a variety of learning opportunities designed to enhance professional capabilities and support career progression.
These opportunities may include:
- Internal training programs.
- Professional development workshops.
- Technical and functional skills training.
- Leadership development initiatives.
- Knowledge-sharing sessions.
- Industry conferences, webinars, and seminars.
- Compliance and workplace training programs.
Training programs are designed to support both current job performance and future career aspirations.
## Taking Ownership of Your Development
Career development is a shared responsibility between employees and managers.
Employees are encouraged to:
- Set meaningful development goals.
- Identify areas for improvement and growth.
- Seek feedback regularly.
- Participate actively in learning opportunities.
- Discuss career aspirations with their managers.
By taking ownership of development, employees can build the skills and experiences needed to achieve their career objectives.
## Performance & Growth Conversations
Regular feedback plays an important role in professional growth.
At IMS, performance discussions are intended to support development, recognize achievements, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
These conversations provide an opportunity to:
- Review accomplishments and contributions.
- Discuss strengths and development areas.
- Align individual goals with business objectives.
- Explore future growth opportunities.
- Create action plans for continued success.
Constructive feedback helps employees develop confidence, capability, and effectiveness in their roles.
## Internal Career Opportunities
Whenever possible, IMS seeks to support employee growth through internal career opportunities.
Employees may have opportunities to:
- Take on expanded responsibilities.
- Explore new functions or departments.
- Participate in cross-functional projects.
- Develop new competencies and experiences.
- Advance into leadership and specialist roles.
Internal mobility helps employees broaden their skills while supporting organizational growth and succession planning.
## Leadership Development
Strong leadership is critical to our long-term success.
IMS encourages employees with leadership potential to develop the skills needed to inspire teams, drive performance, and contribute to organizational success.
Leadership development may focus on:
- Communication skills.
- Decision-making capabilities.
- Strategic thinking.
- Team development.
- Coaching and mentoring.
- Accountability and ownership.
Leadership opportunities are available at all levels of the organization.
## Knowledge Sharing & Collaboration
Learning is most effective when knowledge is shared.
Employees are encouraged to:
- Share expertise and best practices.
- Support colleagues through mentoring and coaching.
- Participate in collaborative projects.
- Contribute ideas and innovative solutions.
- Foster a culture of continuous learning.
By learning from one another, we strengthen both individual capabilities and team performance.
## Building Your Future at IMS
At IMS, we are committed to helping employees reach their full potential.
We believe that investing in our people creates stronger teams, greater innovation, and long-term success. Through continuous learning, meaningful development opportunities, and a commitment to growth, we empower employees to build rewarding and successful careers.
Your growth contributes to our growth, and together we create a workplace where people can learn, develop, and thrive.

chapters.title: Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
chapters.text:
## Creating a Workplace Where Everyone Belongs
At IMS, we believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion are essential to building a strong, innovative, and successful organization. We are committed to creating a workplace where every individual feels respected, valued, supported, and empowered to contribute their best.
We recognize that our differences make us stronger and that diverse perspectives drive creativity, collaboration, and better decision-making.
## Equal Opportunity for All
IMS is committed to providing equal opportunities in all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, development, promotion, compensation, and career advancement.
Employment-related decisions are based on qualifications, skills, experience, performance, and business needs.
We strive to ensure that every employee has access to opportunities that support their professional growth and success.
## Respect for Individual Differences
Our workforce includes individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, cultures, and ideas.
We value and respect differences including, but not limited to:
- Age
- Gender and gender identity
- Race and ethnicity
- Nationality and cultural background
- Religion or belief
- Disability
- Marital or family status
- Educational background
- Professional experience
- Ways of thinking and problem-solving
We encourage employees to embrace diversity and treat one another with dignity and respect.
## An Inclusive Workplace
Inclusion means creating an environment where every employee feels welcomed, heard, and able to participate fully.
At IMS, we encourage:
- Open and respectful communication.
- Collaboration across teams and functions.
- Appreciation of different perspectives.
- Active participation in discussions and decision-making.
- Fair treatment and equal access to opportunities.
Every employee contributes to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace culture.
## Preventing Discrimination, Harassment & Bullying
IMS is committed to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination, harassment, bullying, intimidation, and any form of inappropriate behavior.
Employees are expected to:
- Treat others with professionalism and respect.
- Maintain appropriate workplace conduct.
- Avoid actions, comments, or behaviors that may be offensive, intimidating, or exclusionary.
- Contribute to a safe and respectful work environment.
Any concerns related to discrimination, harassment, or inappropriate conduct should be reported through the appropriate channels so that they can be addressed promptly and fairly.
## Investigation, Remediation & Support
IMS takes all reports of discrimination, harassment, bullying, retaliation, or inappropriate workplace conduct seriously.
When concerns are raised, IMS will:
- Review and investigate concerns promptly, fairly, and objectively.
- Treat all parties involved with dignity, respect, and confidentiality where reasonably possible.
- Take appropriate corrective or disciplinary actions where violations are confirmed.
- Provide reasonable support measures to affected individuals where appropriate.
- Monitor implemented actions to help prevent recurrence and improve workplace practices.
IMS is committed to promoting a workplace where all employees feel safe, respected, and supported.
## Accessibility & Inclusion
IMS is committed to supporting an accessible workplace and removing barriers that may limit an individual's ability to contribute effectively.
We strive to:
- Promote equal participation and opportunity.
- Support employees with diverse needs.
- Encourage an inclusive work environment.
- Consider accessibility when designing workplace practices and processes.
Creating an accessible workplace that benefits everyone and supports a culture of belonging.
## Inclusive Recruitment & Career Development
IMS aims to attract, develop, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds.
Our approach includes:
- Fair and transparent recruitment practices.
- Objective selection criteria.
- Equal access to training and development opportunities.
- Merit-based career advancement.
- Encouraging diverse talent across all levels of the organization.
We believe that everyone should have the opportunity to succeed based on their abilities and contributions.
## Speaking Up & Supporting One Another
Creating an inclusive workplace requires active participation from everyone.
Employees are encouraged to:
- Speak respectfully and thoughtfully.
- Listen to different perspectives.
- Challenge bias in a constructive manner.
- Support colleagues who may need assistance.
- Raise concerns when behavior is inconsistent with our values.
A culture of respect and inclusion is built through everyday actions and interactions.

chapters.title: Environmental Responsibility
chapters.text:
We recognize our responsibility to minimize the environmental impact of our operations wherever possible.
Employees are encouraged to support environmental stewardship by:
- Conserving energy and resources.
- Reducing unnecessary waste.
- Making responsible purchasing decisions.
- Using materials efficiently.
- Supporting environmentally conscious workplace practices.
Small actions taken consistently can create significant positive outcomes over time.
## Energy Conservation
Reducing energy consumption helps lower environmental impact and supports responsible business operations.
Employees can contribute by:
- Switching off lights and equipment when not in use.
- Using energy-efficient technologies and practices.
- Minimizing unnecessary electricity consumption.
- Supporting initiatives that improve energy efficiency.
Responsible energy use benefits both the environment and our business.
## Waste Reduction & Recycling
Reducing waste is an important part of our sustainability journey.
Employees are encouraged to:
- Minimize paper usage whenever practical.
- Utilize digital solutions where appropriate.
- Reuse materials whenever possible.
- Follow workplace recycling practices.
- Dispose of waste responsibly.
By reducing waste and promoting recycling, we help conserve resources and reduce environmental impact.
## Responsible Use of Resources
Resources should be used thoughtfully and efficiently.
This includes:
- Office supplies and equipment.
- Technology and electronic devices.
- Water and energy resources.
- Business travel and transportation.
- Operational materials and consumables.
Responsible resource management supports long-term sustainability and operational efficiency.
## Community Engagement
We believe that businesses have a responsibility to contribute positively to the communities in which they operate.
IMS supports initiatives that strengthen communities, encourage social responsibility, and create positive social impact.
Employees are encouraged to:
- Participate in community initiatives when opportunities arise.
- Support charitable and social causes.
- Share knowledge and expertise that benefits others.
- Demonstrate responsible citizenship both inside and outside the workplace.
## Sustainability Starts with Us
Sustainability is not limited to company programs—it is reflected in everyday decisions and behaviors.
Every employee can contribute by:
- Thinking responsibly before taking action.
- Considering environmental and social impacts.
- Looking for opportunities to improve processes.
- Supporting sustainability initiatives and goals.
- Encouraging others to adopt responsible practices.
Collective efforts create meaningful and lasting change.
## Looking Ahead
IMS is committed to continuous improvement and responsible growth.
As we move forward, we will continue to explore opportunities to strengthen our sustainability practices, reduce our environmental footprint, and create positive value for our stakeholders.
By working together and making responsible choices every day, we contribute to a more sustainable future for our business, our communities, and the world around us.
Together, we can create lasting impact.
## Speaking Up & Getting Support
## A Culture of Open Communication
At IMS, we believe that open communication is essential to a positive, respectful, and productive workplace. Employees are encouraged to share ideas, ask questions, seek guidance, and raise concerns without hesitation.
Creating a workplace where people feel comfortable speaking up helps us build trust, strengthen relationships, and continuously improve as an organization.
## When to Speak Up
Employees are encouraged to raise concerns or seek support whenever they encounter situations that may affect themselves, their colleagues, or the organization.
This may include concerns related to:
- Workplace conduct or behavior.
- Health, safety, or wellbeing.
- Harassment, discrimination, or bullying.
- Ethical concerns or misconduct.
- Conflicts within teams.
- Information security or confidentiality.
- Any situation that may impact the workplace environment.
Early communication often helps resolve concerns quickly and effectively.
## Seeking Guidance
There may be times when employees need advice, clarification, or support in making decisions.
Employees are encouraged to seek guidance from:
- Their immediate manager.
- Department leaders.
- Human Resources.
- Other designated company representatives, as appropriate.
No one is expected to handle difficult situations alone. Seeking support is a sign of responsibility and professionalism.
## Raising Concerns
IMS encourages employees to raise concerns in a respectful and constructive manner.
When concerns are raised, the organization aims to:
- Listen carefully and objectively.
- Treat individuals with respect and fairness.
- Review concerns appropriately.
- Take reasonable steps to address issues when necessary.
- Promote solutions that support a positive workplace environment.

chapters.title: Confidentiality
chapters.text:
IMS recognizes the importance of privacy when concerns are reported.
Information related to concerns, complaints, or workplace issues will be handled as confidentially as reasonably possible, while allowing appropriate review and resolution of the matter.
Employees are encouraged to respect the privacy of others and avoid unnecessary disclosure of sensitive information.
## Non-Retaliation Commitment
IMS is committed to maintaining an environment where employees can raise concerns in good faith without fear of retaliation.
No employee should experience adverse treatment for:
- Reporting a concern.
- Seeking guidance.
- Participating in a workplace review or investigation.
- Providing information honestly and in good faith.
Respectful reporting helps strengthen our workplace culture and supports organizational integrity.
## Supporting One Another
A positive workplace is built when employees support and respect one another.
Employees are encouraged to:
- Listen with empathy and understanding.
- Offer assistance when colleagues need support.
- Foster respectful and constructive dialogue.
- Contribute to a culture of trust and collaboration.
- Promote inclusion, fairness, and mutual respect.
Small acts of support can have a meaningful impact on the wellbeing and success of others.
## Working Through Challenges Together
Challenges and disagreements may occasionally arise in any workplace. At IMS, we believe that most issues can be addressed through open communication, mutual respect, and a willingness to find constructive solutions.
Employees are encouraged to approach challenges professionally, respectfully, and with a focus on achieving positive outcomes.
## Raising Concerns with Confidence
IMS encourages employees to speak up when they have questions, concerns, or observations related to workplace conduct, wellbeing, safety, ethics, or other workplace matters.
Concerns may be raised through managers, Human Resources, or other designated company representatives.
All concerns raised in good faith will be treated respectfully and reviewed appropriately. IMS is committed to maintaining confidentiality whenever reasonably possible and does not tolerate retaliation against individuals who raise concerns or participate in workplace reviews in good faith.
## Our Commitment
At IMS, every voice matters.
We are committed to fostering a workplace where employees feel comfortable asking questions, sharing ideas, raising concerns, and seeking support when needed.
By communicating openly and supporting one another, we create a stronger, healthier, and more successful workplace for everyone.
## Our Commitment to You
## Growing Together
At IMS, we recognize that our success is driven by the dedication, talent, and contributions of our people. We are committed to creating an environment where employees feel valued, supported, and empowered to achieve their full potential.
This commitment guides how we work, how we support one another, and how we build our future together.
## What You Can Expect from IMS
As a member of the IMS team, you can expect us to:
## Provide a Respectful Workplace
We are committed to fostering a workplace built on dignity, respect, fairness, and inclusion where everyone feels welcome and valued.
## Support Your Growth
We encourage continuous learning and development by providing opportunities to build skills, gain experience, and pursue professional growth.
## Promote Health, Safety & Wellbeing
We strive to maintain a safe, healthy, and supportive work environment that promotes employee wellbeing and work-life balance.
## Encourage Open Communication
We value transparency, collaboration, and constructive dialogue. Employees are encouraged to share ideas, ask questions, and contribute to continuous improvement.
## Recognize Contributions
We appreciate the efforts and achievements of our employees and believe that recognition plays an important role in creating a positive and motivating workplace.
## Operate Responsibly
We are committed to conducting business ethically, responsibly, and sustainably while creating value for our stakeholders and communities.
## What IMS Asks of You
In return, we ask every employee to:
## Live Our Values
Demonstrate integrity, respect, accountability, collaboration, and professionalism in all interactions and activities.
## Take Ownership
Approach your work with commitment, responsibility, and a focus on delivering quality results.
## Continue Learning
Seek opportunities to grow, develop new skills, and contribute innovative ideas.
## Support Your Colleagues
Treat others with respect, collaborate openly, and contribute to a positive workplace culture.
## Act Responsibly
Make decisions that reflect our values and contribute to the long-term success of IMS.
## Make a Positive Impact
Support our efforts to operate sustainably, serve our clients effectively, and contribute positively to our communities.
## Building Our Future Together
